highlights: Keep API keys in the Vault: every agent on the server can use them, and the key never goes into the chat.
Remove the downloaded CLI of a provider that is off, in Settings > Providers, to free disk space.
Save a password that you type in the secure card to the Vault of a joined server.
Text that you do not send in a side thread now stays there after a turn ends or a restart.
OpenBot now quits fully when a file operation never finishes, and long Codex and Pi compactions run to the end.
